name: Pasupati Fincap Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Pasupati Fincap 
Ltd deals in hire-purchase, bill discounting, securities, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PFCL is involved in hire-purchase, bill discounting, dealing in securities, and related activities. It also plans to offer merchant banking advisory services, manage debt and equity placements, provide issue management services, and engage in other fund-based investments in the primary market.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
